title: Divide and Conquer
statementMd:
Segment tree is a data structure based on the divide-and-conquer algorithm, but this has nothing to do with this problem. It's just to make the title start with D.

For this problem, a segment tree is a perfect binary tree. A segment tree of depth $n$ has exactly $2^{n+1}-1$ nodes. Note that the root has depth $0$, so a segment tree of depth $n$ has $n+1$ levels.

To make the structure of a segment tree easier to describe, we assign indices to its nodes. The root is assigned index $1$. Every non-leaf node is assigned an index $k$ satisfying $1\leq k \lt 2^n$. It has exactly two children: its left child has index $2k$, and its right child has index $2k+1$.

Each node of a segment tree also has a value. Let $a_k$ denote the value of node $k$. For every non-leaf node $k$, its value $a_k$ must be the maximum of the values of its two children; that is,

$$ a_k=\max\{a_{2k},a_{2k+1}\}. $$

The leaf nodes have indices $2^n,2^n+1,\ldots,2^{n+1}-1$, and their values must form a permutation of $1,2,\ldots,2^n$. In other words, the elements of the sequence $a_{2^n},a_{2^n+1},\ldots,a_{2^{n+1}-1}$ must be pairwise distinct integers, and $1\leq a_{2^n+i}\leq 2^n$ must hold for every $0\leq i \lt 2^n$.

There are now $q$ constraints. The $i$-th constraint is of the form $(u_i,x_i)$. Here, $u_i$ is a node index and $x_i$ is a specified value; the constraint requires the value $a_{u_i}$ of node $u_i$ to be equal to $x_i$. Calculate the number of segment trees satisfying all $q$ constraints, or equivalently, the number of distinct valid sequences $a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_{2^{n+1}-1}$. Output the answer modulo $998244353$.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $n$ $(1\le n\le 18)$ and $q$ $(0\le q\le 2^{n+1}-1)$.

Each of the next $q$ lines contains two integers $u_i$ $(1\le u_i \lt 2^{n+1})$ and $x_i$ $(1\le x_i\le 2^n)$, meaning that the value $a_{u_i}$ of node $u_i$ is required to be equal to $x_i$.

## Output

Output one integer: the number of valid leaf permutations modulo $998244353$.

## Note

In Example 1, the four valid segment trees are:

$$ \begin{aligned} \begin{array}{ccccccccccc} &&&&&4&&&&&\\[-0.2em] &&&\diagup&&&&\diagdown&&&\\[-0.2em] &&2&&&&&&4&&\\[-0.2em] &\diagup&&\diagdown&&&&\diagup&&\diagdown&\\[-0.2em] 1&&&&2&&3&&&&4\\ &&&&&\text{(1)}&&&&& \end{array} &\qquad\qquad \begin{array}{ccccccccccc} &&&&&4&&&&&\\[-0.2em] &&&\diagup&&&&\diagdown&&&\\[-0.2em] &&2&&&&&&4&&\\[-0.2em] &\diagup&&\diagdown&&&&\diagup&&\diagdown&\\[-0.2em] 1&&&&2&&4&&&&3\\ &&&&&\text{(2)}&&&&& \end{array} \\[2em] \begin{array}{ccccccccccc} &&&&&4&&&&&\\[-0.2em] &&&\diagup&&&&\diagdown&&&\\[-0.2em] &&2&&&&&&4&&\\[-0.2em] &\diagup&&\diagdown&&&&\diagup&&\diagdown&\\[-0.2em] 2&&&&1&&3&&&&4\\ &&&&&\text{(3)}&&&&& \end{array} &\qquad\qquad \begin{array}{ccccccccccc} &&&&&4&&&&&\\[-0.2em] &&&\diagup&&&&\diagdown&&&\\[-0.2em] &&2&&&&&&4&&\\[-0.2em] &\diagup&&\diagdown&&&&\diagup&&\diagdown&\\[-0.2em] 2&&&&1&&4&&&&3\\ &&&&&\text{(4)}&&&&& \end{array} \end{aligned} $$

The corresponding arrays are:

$$ \begin{aligned} (a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_7)&=(4,2,4,1,2,3,4) &&\text{in (1)}\\ (a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_7)&=(4,2,4,1,2,4,3) &&\text{in (2)}\\ (a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_7)&=(4,2,4,2,1,3,4) &&\text{in (3)}\\ (a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_7)&=(4,2,4,2,1,4,3) &&\text{in (4)} \end{aligned} $$

Therefore, the answer is $4$.

In Example 2, the root always has value $4$, since $4$ is the maximum leaf value. The condition $a_2=4$ requires the leaf with value $4$ to be either node $4$ or node $5$. After choosing its position, the other three values can be placed arbitrarily, giving $2\times 3!=12$ valid leaf permutations.

In Example 3, $a_2=\max\{a_4,a_5\}$ must be at least $a_4=4$, so it cannot be equal to $3$. Thus, no valid leaf permutation exists.

In Example 4, the two constraints require $a_1$ to be both $2$ and $3$, which is impossible.
statementZhMd:
线段树是一种基于分治算法的数据结构，不过这与本题无关。这里只是为了让题名以 D 开头。

在本题中，线段树是一棵满二叉树。深度为 $n$ 的线段树恰好有 $2^{n+1}-1$ 个节点。注意，根节点的深度为 $0$，因此深度为 $n$ 的线段树共有 $n+1$ 层。

为了便于描述线段树的结构，我们为其节点编号。根节点的编号为 $1$。每个非叶节点的编号 $k$ 满足 $1\leq k \lt 2^n$。它恰好有两个子节点：左子节点的编号为 $2k$，右子节点的编号为 $2k+1$。

线段树的每个节点还有一个值。用 $a_k$ 表示节点 $k$ 的值。对于每个非叶节点 $k$，其值 $a_k$ 必须等于两个子节点的值的最大值，即

$$ a_k=\max\{a_{2k},a_{2k+1}\}. $$

叶节点的编号为 $2^n,2^n+1,\ldots,2^{n+1}-1$，它们的值必须构成 $1,2,\ldots,2^n$ 的一个排列。换言之，序列 $a_{2^n},a_{2^n+1},\ldots,a_{2^{n+1}-1}$ 中的元素必须是两两不同的整数，并且对于每个 $0\leq i \lt 2^n$，都必须满足 $1\leq a_{2^n+i}\leq 2^n$。

现在有 $q$ 个约束。第 $i$ 个约束的形式为 $(u_i,x_i)$。其中，$u_i$ 是节点编号，$x_i$ 是指定的值；该约束要求节点 $u_i$ 的值 $a_{u_i}$ 等于 $x_i$。请计算满足全部 $q$ 个约束的线段树数量，等价地，也就是不同的合法序列 $a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_{2^{n+1}-1}$ 的数量。答案对 $998244353$ 取模。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $n$ $(1\le n\le 18)$ 和 $q$ $(0\le q\le 2^{n+1}-1)$。

接下来 $q$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $u_i$ $(1\le u_i \lt 2^{n+1})$ 和 $x_i$ $(1\le x_i\le 2^n)$，表示要求节点 $u_i$ 的值 $a_{u_i}$ 等于 $x_i$。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示合法的叶节点值排列数量对 $998244353$ 取模的结果。

## 说明

在样例 1 中，四棵合法的线段树如下：

$$ \begin{aligned} \begin{array}{ccccccccccc} &&&&&4&&&&&\\[-0.2em] &&&\diagup&&&&\diagdown&&&\\[-0.2em] &&2&&&&&&4&&\\[-0.2em] &\diagup&&\diagdown&&&&\diagup&&\diagdown&\\[-0.2em] 1&&&&2&&3&&&&4\\ &&&&&\text{(1)}&&&&& \end{array} &\qquad\qquad \begin{array}{ccccccccccc} &&&&&4&&&&&\\[-0.2em] &&&\diagup&&&&\diagdown&&&\\[-0.2em] &&2&&&&&&4&&\\[-0.2em] &\diagup&&\diagdown&&&&\diagup&&\diagdown&\\[-0.2em] 1&&&&2&&4&&&&3\\ &&&&&\text{(2)}&&&&& \end{array} \\[2em] \begin{array}{ccccccccccc} &&&&&4&&&&&\\[-0.2em] &&&\diagup&&&&\diagdown&&&\\[-0.2em] &&2&&&&&&4&&\\[-0.2em] &\diagup&&\diagdown&&&&\diagup&&\diagdown&\\[-0.2em] 2&&&&1&&3&&&&4\\ &&&&&\text{(3)}&&&&& \end{array} &\qquad\qquad \begin{array}{ccccccccccc} &&&&&4&&&&&\\[-0.2em] &&&\diagup&&&&\diagdown&&&\\[-0.2em] &&2&&&&&&4&&\\[-0.2em] &\diagup&&\diagdown&&&&\diagup&&\diagdown&\\[-0.2em] 2&&&&1&&4&&&&3\\ &&&&&\text{(4)}&&&&& \end{array} \end{aligned} $$

对应的数组为：

$$ \begin{aligned} (a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_7)&=(4,2,4,1,2,3,4) &&\text{in (1)}\\ (a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_7)&=(4,2,4,1,2,4,3) &&\text{in (2)}\\ (a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_7)&=(4,2,4,2,1,3,4) &&\text{in (3)}\\ (a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_7)&=(4,2,4,2,1,4,3) &&\text{in (4)} \end{aligned} $$

因此，答案为 $4$。

在样例 2 中，由于叶节点值的最大值为 $4$，根节点的值始终为 $4$。条件 $a_2=4$ 要求值为 $4$ 的叶节点只能是节点 $4$ 或节点 $5$。选定其位置后，其余三个值可以任意放置，因此共有 $2\times 3!=12$ 种合法的叶节点值排列。

在样例 3 中，$a_2=\max\{a_4,a_5\}$ 必须至少为 $a_4=4$，因此不可能等于 $3$。所以不存在合法的叶节点值排列。

在样例 4 中，两个约束要求 $a_1$ 同时等于 $2$ 和 $3$，这是不可能的。
